prompt:
The section sections/multicolumn-features-2.liquid has markup that is correct, but its {% schema %} block was written with ids, block types and option values in the wrong letter case. The markup reads section.settings.title, section.settings.columns_desktop, section.settings.text_alignment, and for blocks of type column it reads block.settings.heading, block.settings.text and block.settings.icon. Liquid lookups and Shopify schema values are case-sensitive, so every id, type and value must match exactly. Do not change the markup. Replace the schema JSON so that it is exactly this schema; key order does not matter:
- name: "Multicolumn features"; tag: "section"; class: "multicolumn-features".
- settings, in this order:
  1. type "text", id "title", label "Title", default "Why shop with us".
  2. type "range", id "columns_desktop", label "Columns on desktop", min 1, max 4, step 1, default 3. All four numbers are JSON numbers.
  3. type "select", id "text_alignment", label "Text alignment", options [{value "left", label "Left"}, {value "center", label "Center"}], default "center".
- blocks: exactly one block definition with type "column" and name "Column". Its settings, in this order:
  1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Feature".
  2. type "richtext", id "text", label "Text". It has no default.
  3. type "select", id "icon", label "Icon", options [{value "truck", label "Truck"}, {value "gift", label "Gift"}, {value "lock", label "Lock"}], default "truck".
- max_blocks: 6 (a number).
- presets: one preset with name "Multicolumn features" and blocks [{type "column"}, {type "column"}, {type "column"}].
All ids, types and option values are lowercase exactly as written. Labels and names keep the capitalization shown. Do not add any other keys. Change only sections/multicolumn-features-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
